title: SFBond 실버폭스 #022 · 금박 · 발목 쇠공 · 체형 curvy petite · Korean · early 50s · 헤어 vintage victory rolls framing the face
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Korean woman, a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, early 50s silver fox goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, silver-white vintage victory rolls framing the face — full body applied ELECTRIC MAGENTA leaf covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles. Thin irregular metallic sheets — BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA leaf with fine natural creases and overlapping seams across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID SILVER undertone glinting through the thinnest points, a soft warm metallic sheen filling every gap, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges. A faint streak of soot crosses her cheekbone, and a little grime darkens her fingertips and the soles of her bare feet. Her expression is a quiet, serious expression. Restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, and from the middle of that short chain a longer chain of the same links runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball that rests on the flagstones beside her feet. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips. Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her shoulders slightly lowered, her head bowed a little, her bare feet close together flat on the flagstones, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long coffin holographic nails magenta silver tips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
